prior_results.cold_stage_c: Retained as a quantified exploration-bottleneck negative result, not pooled with this campaign.
prior_results.first_warmstart: Failed its frozen 0.15-0.25 support gate and supplied no initialization.
prior_results.backend_parity: Failed. Direct Hugging Face adapter scores are excluded from checkpoint selection; vLLM is authoritative.

factor_separation.exploration: One SFT checkpoint is selected before reward evaluation and becomes the byte-identical initialization for all three credit arms.
factor_separation.proposal_mechanisms: No teacher mixture, uniform mixture, forced inclusion, diversity proposal, or importance weighting is used. Such proposals remain a separately named future factor and may not be added to only a ReDCO arm.
factor_separation.claim_boundary: The campaign tests credit assignment on a deliberately minimal planted-needle bandit after shared exploration support. It does not estimate an exploration-by-credit interaction against the historical cold campaign.

sft_calibration.dataset: The unchanged 32-example planted-needle action-5 demonstration set with calibration seeds 20000-20031 and no held-out reward use.

authoritative_selection.backend: pinned vLLM on exact recorded prefix_token_ids
authoritative_selection.temperature_method: Request one complete raw-vocabulary logprob map per model at temperature 1, then compute softmax(logits / T) exactly for T=1 and T=2. Do not interpret vLLM completion logprobs as already retempered.
authoritative_selection.failure: If no checkpoint passes, record a second warm-start calibration failure, retain compact score evidence, terminate compute, and do not run any credit arm.

merge_gate.operation: Merge only the selected LoRA into an ephemeral copy of the exact base model.
merge_gate.comparison_backend: vLLM for both the selected adapter and merged model
merge_gate.merged_model_retention: ephemeral only; never copy the 4B merged weights locally

conditional_credit_campaign.condition: The SFT selection and merge gates pass and a selected-adapter plus merged-model manifest is frozen before the first RL model call.
conditional_credit_campaign.order_reason: Place the control between the two replay-equivalent ReDCO arms rather than always first or last.
primary_measurements: final exact-prefix vLLM action-5 mass at temperature 2
informative branch-group rate and zero-advantage rate
conditional_credit_campaign.evaluation_scope: The 64 evaluation traces are operational repeated-state checks, not 64 independent statistical units. No pseudo-replicated confidence interval will be reported.

decision_rule.integration: Every arm completes its frozen optimizer-step and policy-call budget from the same initialization; every ReDCO episode contains one context plus 11 contiguous branch indices; every branch uses the recorded behavior temperature and one sampled token; no gathered full-model checkpoint is retained.
decision_rule.credit_signal: Report exact differences without a formal population-level significance claim. A mechanistic positive result requires both ReDCO arms to exceed broadcast final action-5 mass by at least 0.02 and to have at least one informative group and one nonzero finite-gradient step.
decision_rule.replay_equivalence: Sliced and full-suffix final action-5 masses differ by at most 0.05 and their greedy action agrees.
decision_rule.failure: Report the frozen outcome without threshold relaxation or retry.

online_resource_and_signal_policy.prelaunch_abort: Do not launch RL unless the selected vLLM mass implies at least 4.75 expected informative groups per optimizer step.
online_resource_and_signal_policy.cost_note: A completed 12-step ReDCO arm is short enough that an additional stochastic early-abort rule would add selection bias; all observed zero-signal steps are retained and reported.
online_resource_and_signal_policy.gpu: At most one non-spot 2x48GB non-A100/non-H100 pod at no more than $2.00/hour.
online_resource_and_signal_policy.reuse: If SFT passes, reuse the same ephemeral pod and uv/model cache through the conditional arms.
